title: Furnishing Pack: Winter's Feast
flavorText: Gather your loved ones around you and celebrate New Life with a feast! Festive food, drink, and decorations make this pack indispensable for those who love spreading cheer.
name: Furnishing Pack: Winter's Feast

title: Worm King's Sarcophagus, Necropolis Replica
flavorText: "Mage from infancy, blood-selected for magicka, descended from isles of Artaeum forever! Destined was I from long before birth to exceed all mortals."—Excerpted from Worm Saga by Mannimarco
name: Worm King's Sarcophagus, Necropolis Replica

title: Ashbound Hall Aspect Lock, Replica
flavorText: Though this mechanism is a replica, the working locks in Ashbound Hall required special keys called Aspects to open.
name: Ashbound Hall Aspect Lock, Replica

title: Worm Cult Banner, Hanging Red
flavorText: "We know why we're all here, gathered under this blood-red banner. Yes, siblings in necromancy, none shall stop us from achieving our greatest successes. For the King of Worms!"—Bonelord Mukhel
name: Worm Cult Banner, Hanging Red

title: Worm Cult Tent, Cultist's
flavorText: Even Worm Cultists need shelter when out in the field! Set up this tent wherever the weather can get to you, and rest easy knowing that you probably won't wake up with wet socks. Also works well as guest accommodations.
name: Worm Cult Tent, Cultist's

title: Furnishing Pack: Writhing Fortress
flavorText: The Writhing Wall and its intimidating architectural elements darken the sun-drenched island of Solstice. Add touches of this grim style to your own home by using the banners, black soul gems, and more included in this pack.
name: Furnishing Pack: Writhing Fortress

title: Bearer of Fargrave, Skeletal Jaw
flavorText: It's said that in ages long past these great colossi once hefted Fargrave onto their shoulders, transporting it down a great and winding road. This endless procession wore paths in the very fabric of the Aurbis that still survive to this day.
name: Bearer of Fargrave, Skeletal Jaw

title: Bearer of Fargrave, Broken Skull
flavorText: How the Bearers of Fargrave met their end is a mystery known to no mortal or Daedra yet living. It's said a great and terrible calamity occurred, the Bearers forgot their purpose, and they met their ends as aetherial sands rose to consume them.
name: Bearer of Fargrave, Broken Skull

title: Imperial Titan Slayer
flavorText: "While I still stand, the Empire yet lives, filth. For the Emperor! For Cyrodiil!"
name: Imperial Titan Slayer

title: Valenwood Skull Blocks
flavorText: "Aren't they incredible? I did the alchemical peeling and preservation and a friend did the enchantment. I'm on leave from the rangers next week, we're going to play for King Camoran himself!" - Glooredel

title: Hourglass of Akatosh Brace, Massive
flavorText: "To one such as I, time itself can be shaped. It can be moulded. It can be broken. When I command the sands, all will know of my artistry." - B'Kyfxi
name: Hourglass of Akatosh Brace, Massive

title: Shattered Paths Signet
enchantDescription: Reduce Health, Magicka, and Stamina cost of abilities by |cffffff133|r. This effect does not work with abilities that drain their cost multiple times over their activation.
flavorText: Occluded are the poems which sing of shattered paths. Fractured rhymes. Marred cantos. Ruined verse. Perhaps, in obstruction, a more perfect reflection is captured. -Hivisk the Blind
name: Shattered Paths Signet

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) Increase your damage done to monsters with status effects by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r Ultimate you have, up to |cffffff133|r%. The cap is halved if Feral Guardian is active.

While you have |cffffff133|r or more Ultimate, your Light and Heavy Attacks apply a random status effect, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

While equipped, applies Minor Timidity to you, consuming |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds in combat.

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff439|r, Maximum Stamina by |cffffff439|r, and Maximum Health by |cffffff482|r.

title: Curated Tamriel Reward Coffer
flavorText: This curated coffer contains an uncollected piece of Mother's Sorrow set armor from Deshaan, Briarheart set armor from Wrothgar or Plague Doctor set armor from Deshaan.
name: Curated Tamriel Reward Coffer

title: Curated Dungeon Reward Coffer
flavorText: This curated coffer contains an uncollected piece of Burning Spellweave set armor from City of Ash, Hircine's Veneer set armor from Selene's Web, or Ebon Armory set armor from Crypt of Hearts.
name: Curated Dungeon Reward Coffer

title: Glorious Night Market Reward Coffer
flavorText:
This curated coffer contains an uncollected set armor piece of Burning Spellweave from City of Ash, Hircine's Veneer from Selene's Web, or Ebon Armory from Crypt of Hearts.

It also has a greater chance to contain a Night Market Antiquity Lead.
name: Glorious Night Market Reward Coffer

title: Night Market Daily Reward Coffer
flavorText:
This curated coffer contains an uncollected piece of Mother's Sorrow set armor from Deshaan, Briarheart set armor from Wrothgar or Plague Doctor set armor from Deshaan.

This coffer may also contain a Night Market Antiquity Lead.
name: Night Market Daily Reward Coffer

title: U49 Gift Container
flavorText: Update 49 sees a number of quality-of-life changes coming to the game. Revamped stablemasters, reduced research crafting timers, updates to the outfit system, and more await you. Enclosed are some one-time gifts to help you on your next adventure.
name: U49 Gift Container

title: Glittering Goad Visage
name: Glittering Goad Visage

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Adds 1 Weapon and Spell Damage

(2 items) Dealing damage with a Bash or Heavy Attack deals 3968 Frost damage over |cffffff8|r seconds to the enemy. This effect can occur once every |cffffff8|r seconds.

If the effect completes, the enemy applies Minor Brittle to up to 6 enemies within 12 meters of itself for |cffffff10|r seconds. 

If the enemy dies, the enemy releases glittering energy, restoring 847 Magicka and Stamina to you and group members within 12 meters of the defeated enemy.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 2%.

title: Visage of the Ruckus
name: Visage of the Ruckus

setBonuses.description: (2 items) Taking or dealing direct damage grants you a stack of Skirmish for |cffffff10|r seconds. You can gain Skirmish every |cffffff1|r second, up to |cffffff10|r stacks. Lose |cffffff1|r stack every |cffffff5|r seconds when not taking or dealing damage. At max stacks, you no longer gain or lose stacks of Skirmish and you gain Major Protection, Major Expedition, and Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds. When max Skirmish ends, your Stamina, Magicka, and Health Recovery are reduced by 422 for |cffffff10|r seconds.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 2%.

flavorText: "Anger not the deranged Prince or he will slice you up like quince."—Excerpt from "Aspects of the Mad God"

title: Aspect of the Mad God, Amusement
flavorText: "Amusement reigns, or so you wish. Yet pain sweeps in—his favorite dish."—Excerpt from "Aspects of the Mad God"

title: Aspect of the Mad God, Laughter
flavorText: "You may giggle, losing breath. Our Prince then laughs upon your death."—Excerpt from "Aspects of the Mad God"

Improved Somnal Powder
abilityDescription: Up to 6 living humanoids within 2.5 meters are disoriented and cannot witness crimes for |cffffff11|r seconds. Interacting with a target - including pickpocketing - will end the effect.
flavorText: A single use ball of clay that breaks open to release alchemical sleeping powder in a small cloud. Useful as a brief distraction when one needs to slip past unseen. This version affects a larger area, more targets, for a longer duration.

title: Furnishing Pack: Darien's Delights
flavorText: Darien Gautier, hero of Daggerfall. Golden Knight. Bread connoisseur. And the subject of this furnishing pack, which features paintings, bread, and a glorious statue of him as the Golden Knight.

title: Granny's Eel Pie
abilityDescription:
Increase Max Health by |cffffff5790|r, Poison Resistance by |cffffff5464|r, and Healing Taken by |cffffff7|r%.
While in Werewolf form, increase Block Mitigation by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
flavorText: Over several centuries, Granny Tarani Aerith perfected the pie that made her famous. The perfected recipe showcases a rich viper eel stew encased in flaky pastry and baked to perfection.

title: Curated Bahraha's Curse Coffer
flavorText: This curated coffer contains an uncollected superior piece of armor from the Bahraha's Curse item set.

title: Thieves Guild Daily Coffer
flavorText: Rewards from the Glenumbra Thieves Guild for services rendered. Contains set items, style items, and motif pages for the discerning light-fingered footpad.

title: Red Lichen
flavorText: An ingredient for crafting food.

title: Phynaster's Gem of Stealth
flavorText: One of the legendary Gems of Phynaster the Prowler that once adorned the Prowler's Amulet. Found hidden within another relic, the Thieves Moon. Seek out Mylen Dechery at the Glenumbra Thieves Den to unlock the gem's potential.

title: Phynaster's Gem of Agility
flavorText: One of the legendary Gems of Phynaster the Prowler that once adorned the Prowler's Amulet. Found while dealing with emerging threats across Tamriel. Seek out Mylen Dechery at the Glenumbra Thieves Den to unlock the gem's potential.

title: Phynaster's Gem of Deception
flavorText: One of the legendary Gems of Phynaster the Prowler that once adorned the Prowler's Amulet. Found while chasing down intriguing rumors across Tamriel. Seek out Mylen Dechery at the Glenumbra Thieves Den to unlock the gem's potential.

title: Phynaster's Gem of Cunning
flavorText: One of the legendary Gems of Phynaster the Prowler that once adorned the Prowler's Amulet. Found within the Nowhere Vault of Sage Voernet. Seek out Mylen Dechery at the Glenumbra Thieves Den to unlock the gem's potential.

title: Wherenow Code Key
flavorText:
A multicolored code key needed to decipher secret messages.

When you have the Indecipherable Sai Note, Baffling Baan Dar Note, and Mysterious Nocturnal Note: Use to combine into the Rogue's Refuge house.

Acquired via "A Guild Grows in Glenumbra" quest.

title: Indecipherable Sai Note
flavorText:
This note starts with "Sai," but the rest needs a code key to decipher.

When you have the Wherenow Code Key, Baffling Baan Dar Note, and Mysterious Nocturnal Note: Use to combine into the Rogue's Refuge house.

Acquired via Thieves Troves and safeboxes.

title: Baffling Baan Dar Note
flavorText:
This note starts with "Baan Dar," but the rest needs a code key to decipher.

When you have the Wherenow Code Key, Indecipherable Sai Note, and Mysterious Nocturnal Note: Use to combine into the Rogue's Refuge house.

Acquired via Dynamic Events.

title: Mysterious Nocturnal Note
flavorText:
This note starts with "Nocturnal," but the rest needs a code key to decipher.

When you have the Wherenow Code Key, Indecipherable Sai Note, and Baffling Baan Dar Note: Use to combine into the Rogue's Refuge house.

Acquired via Thieves Guild Heists.

title: Shard of Parched Stone
flavorText: Consume 10 Shards of Parched Stone to unlock the Skill Stylist: Blood Scion achievement and the Blood Scion, Coldharbour Skill Style.

title: Bitten Chew Bone
flavorText: Consume 1, 5, and 10 Bitten Chew Bones to unlock various Werewolf Form Skill Stylist achievements and various Werewolf Form Skill Styles.
